_note: textFr = French text (shown when the app is in French; titles stay in English). Chance = bonuses only. Special = penalties and tricky cards. 'effect' lets the app apply the card (see the comment at the top of js/screens/event.js).

chance.title: Good Connection!
chance.text: Choose a player to move forward 2 spaces with you.
chance.textFr: Choisis un joueur qui avance de 2 cases avec toi.

chance.title: Lucky Jump!
chance.text: Move to the next Chance space!
chance.textFr: Va jusqu’à la prochaine case Chance !

chance.title: Golden Shield
chance.text: If you answer your next question wrong, you don't move back.
chance.textFr: Si tu te trompes à ta prochaine question, tu ne recules pas.

chance.title: Help!!
chance.text: You can ask another player for help with your next question. If the answer is right, your helper moves forward 1 space. If it's wrong, they stay where they are.
chance.textFr: Tu peux demander de l’aide à un autre joueur pour ta prochaine question. Si la réponse est juste, ton aidant avance d’1 case. Sinon, il reste sur place.

special.title: Brain Swap!
special.text: Choose another player to answer your question. They move instead of you.
special.textFr: Choisis un autre joueur qui répond à ta question. C’est lui qui bouge à ta place.

special.title: 404 Error!
special.text: You are lost! Move back 4 spaces.
special.textFr: Tu es perdu ! Recule de 4 cases.

special.title: Freeze!
special.text: Choose a player to skip their next turn.
special.textFr: Choisis un joueur qui passe son prochain tour.

special.title: Double Trouble!
special.text: Your next correct answer moves you forward twice as many spaces.
special.textFr: Ta prochaine bonne réponse te fait avancer deux fois plus.
